_comment: A miniature registration (issue #1407 fallout, counter-model finding 4).
The gate needs only curl, which the wrapper genuinely stages and the
control genuinely (and correctly) claims as provided. But the WRAPPER
itself independently hard-requires jq, unconditionally, before it ever
stages the curl stub or runs the gate. jq must still be reported as
needed and unprovided - pinning that a wrapper's OWN hard-required
binaries are ADDED to what requirements() reports, not only the gate's.
Removing that additive walk would leave this case passing by accident,
since nothing else here surfaces jq.
